text: epochs Passes training data. NULL trains epochs. warmup_ratio Fraction steps used warm learning rate. weight_decay Weight decay optimizer. logging_steps Steps progress rows. save_steps Steps checkpoints. gradient_checkpointing Trade compute memory.
